Nithari Killings Accused Surendra Koli Dies

Surendra Koli, an accused in the Nithari killings case, has died. An autopsy report stated he died of asphyxia. One report indicated he died by suicide, and that he had been acquitted in the Nithari killings case. Koli was known by the moniker "Butcher of Nithari".
